name: babble
description: Online multiplayer 'spell what you hear' game. An engine generates words (real languages or gibberish), players hear them and spell them, and a phonetic decoder scores how close each guess sounds to the original.

scripts.test: node test/phonetics.test.js && node test/tts.test.js && node test/bots.test.js && node test/game.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: node test/integration.test.js && node test/features.test.js && node test/boss.test.js
